name: perform-editing-operations
description:
Apply one or more draft changes to the content or layout of an existing Canva design within an active editing transaction.

Use to revise, rewrite, or translate text; replace, insert, position, or resize images and videos on a page; remove page elements; edit text formatting; update a design title; or label fixed-page elements.

Not for changing a design's page structure or order.

Changes are temporary until saved. Show the user a preview of their changes and obtain explicit approval before saving changes.

Returns the updated page state for further changes, previewing, saving, or discarding.

operations.description: The editing operations to perform on the design in this editing transaction. Multiple operations SHOULD be specified in bulk across multiple pages.

title.description: The new title for the design

element_id.description: The ID of the element to replace the text of.

text.description: The new text to replace the existing text with.

alt_text.description: The alternate text of the new asset

asset_type.description: The type of the new asset

element_id.description: The ID of the image or video element whose fill should be replaced.

alt_text.description: The alternate text of the asset

asset_type.description: The type of the asset to insert

height.description: Height in pixels. Must be > 0. If not specified, a default height will be used

left.description: Left position in pixels. If not specified, a default position will be used

page_id.description: The ID of the page to insert the fill into

top.description: Top position in pixels. If not specified, a default position will be used

width.description: Width in pixels. Must be > 0. If not specified, a default width will be used

element_id.description: The ID of the element to delete.
The ID of the element to find and replace the text in.

find_text.description: The text that is needs to be found to be replaced.

replace_text.description: The new text to replace the existing text with.

element_id.description: The ID of the element to reposition.

left.description: Left position in pixels (relative to page).

top.description: Top position in pixels (relative to page).

anyOf.description: Resizes an existing element (image, video, text, etc.) to a new size on the page. IMPORTANT: For TEXT elements, only specify width (height is auto-calculated). For IMAGE/VIDEO elements: if preserve_aspect_ratio=true, specify ONLY width OR height (the other is calculated); if preserve_aspect_ratio=false, specify both width and height.

element_id.description: The ID of the element to resize.

height.description: The height in pixels of the element. For TEXT elements: do NOT provide height - it will be automatically calculated. For other elements: if preserve_aspect_ratio is true, provide either width OR height (not both) - the other dimension will be calculated. If preserve_aspect_ratio is false, provide both width and height.

preserve_aspect_ratio.description: Whether to preserve the aspect ratio of the element. If true, provide only ONE dimension (width or height) - the other will be calculated automatically. If false, provide both dimensions.

width.description: The width in pixels of the element. Required unless preserve_aspect_ratio is true and height is provided.

element_id.description: The ID of the text element to format.

formatting.description: The formatting options to apply to the text

font_size.description: The size of text in pixels. Must be between 1 and 800

link.description: URL string. Setting to empty string removes any existing link

list_level.description: List nesting level. 0 removes list formatting (not a list item). 1 is the outermost level, with higher values (e.g., 2, 3, etc.) increasing the nesting depth.

list_marker.description: List marker style (only applies when list_level > 0): none, disc, circle, square, decimal, lower-alpha, or lower-roman

text_align.description: Text alignment: start, center, or end

anyOf.description: Connects or removes an autofill field label on a text or image element. This is only supported on fixed-page designs.

autofill_field_label.description: The autofill field label to connect to the element. Omit this property to remove an existing autofill field mapping.

element_id.description: The ID of the text or image element to connect to an autofill field.

page_index.description: Required page index of the first page that is going to be updated as part of this update. Multiple operations SHOULD be specified in bulk across multiple pages, this just needs to specify the first page in the set of pages to be updated. Pages are indexed using one-based numbering, so the first page in a design has the index value `1`.

pages.description: The list of all pages in the design. This must be the `pages` array returned by the last call to `perform-editing-operations` or if this is the first call the `start-editing-transaction` tool. Used to determine which pages are responsive and editable.

transaction_id.description: The editing transaction ID. This must be the exact `transaction_id` value returned in the `start-editing-transaction` tool response for the editing transaction to perform editing operations on.

user_intent.description: Mandatory description of what the user is trying to accomplish with this tool call. This should always be provided by LLM clients. Please keep it concise (255 characters or less recommended).
